comments_data.body:
@lebaphi said:

Hi @IanMayo and @ShendMikullovci ,
I've update the UI:
- The text editing, I add the border bottom to make it like editing field
- Color picking, I don't think add the underline is a good UI, so I think we set the cursor to point is good enough.
- Change icon, I added the underline and change cursor to pointer.
How do you think, guys?

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26705621/146488214-f278786e-4d9f-4ddb-a09a-001a59fde2aa.png)

For this `White` force (above) it isn't obvious that there is the clickable color block there.  A dark solid border would show the user there's something there.

Hmm, @ShendMikullovci - should we put a `Color` label to the left of the color block?
That sounds good! However, the deployment link is sending me to the game, not the admin page, so I can't really see what it looks like!
I definitely like keeping the point cursor for all of the options, as well as add a darker border for the team color icon.

> That sounds good! However, the deployment link is sending me to the game, not the admin page, so I can't really see what it looks like!

From the game page you click on the `Admin` icon at the upper-right:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/146750804-02c112de-a329-46b1-abe1-496c2c76bf77.png)

>  as well as add a darker border for the team color icon.

@lebaphi - could you add a darker border around the force color icon?

> > as well as add a darker border for the team color icon.
> 
> @lebaphi - could you add a darker border around the force color icon?

sure @IanMayo 👍
Hello @lebaphi - if you set that darker border color, we can get this PR merged :-)

Hi @IanMayo @ShendMikullovci , which one do you think better:

border 1px:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26705621/147042464-33f15cb0-0baf-4b8c-a2a6-9c3846caeae3.png)

border 2px
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26705621/147042393-a87284f3-bded-4550-a621-66090334ef21.png)

I pushed the change with 1px border. but if you guys think it should be bolder, I will update 😄

Both look great to me. If you've pushed 1px then let's stick to it. 
Thanks guys!

issues.title: Make Options Appear Clickable
issues.body:
The force name, icon change tabs, and the color chart should be rendered to appear more clickable:
![Make appear clickable admin page](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/145839420-4ef23949-749a-4fbb-b558-620d8fa967a6.png)
 
This could be done simply by underlining the force name and the "Change Icon". As for the color chart, its outline could be dimmed.

comments.body: Great, yes.   Let's have underlines please @lebaphi
